description: Rubash source pin for native-shell releases (rubash#827, conclusion B). Every release job fetches exactly this rubash commit into ../rubash -- where the [patch] path override in Cargo.toml deterministically picks it up -- and fails the release unless the checked-out HEAD equals rubash_rev. The compiled engine is pinned to an exact commit instead of being 'whatever rubash master HEAD was at build time'. The engine now comes from JayWanX/rubash (our fork): upstream unixwin/rubash still ships the pre-rename bash shim lookup chain (niu.exe / winuxsh.exe), which cannot find native-shell.exe and exits 127.
notes: Pinned to JayWanX/rubash e84ffd77 - 'Find the host shell by its current name, not the pre-rename one'. That commit rewires the bash shim's locate_shell() from niu.exe/winuxsh.exe to native-shell.exe and renames configured_shell_root_winuxsh -> configured_shell_root_host. Without it a staged <root>/winuxcmd/usr/bin/bash.exe cannot find <root>/native-shell.exe and `bash --help` exits 127 (the staged-release face gate).

Supersedes d75cc150773ae0e961868eb0a409d7d954c4cd65 (unixwin/rubash, v1.4.2). The fork's history is squashed to an Initial commit plus that fix, so the 40-char rev is stable and fetchable by git fetch --depth 1.

The rebranded clone is still requested from JayWanX/rubash in .github/workflows/release.yml and ci.yml, and Cargo.toml's [patch] key matches that URL -- all three must name the same repository or the path override stops applying.
